Leo: :zipper_mouth_face: :eyes: silent panic + watching the calendar

Maya: love the vibes. new rule: whoever posts :snail: owes the team a snack this week :grin:

kudos-bot: Maya gave a shoutout to Ethan for volunteering to snack-run. +1 karma
Priya: also, mini poll: bagels or muffins on Friday? quick reactions pls

Sam: :muffin:
Olivia: both? :pleading_face:
Maya: this thread has officially peaked. thanks for the two-emojis, team :)
